T: The Ministry lies. The snacks don't.
D: Harry forms a secret group of students to fight back while the Ministry takes over Hogwarts.
P: Serve the snacks when Dumbledore's Army meets in the Room of Requirement.
S: Hog's Head pork and sage sausage rolls
the Hog's Head pub where Dumbledore's Army forms

Sausage rolls of pork, onion and sage in puff pastry, baked at 200C for 25 minutes, with English mustard, like a dusty village pub. Mix 500g pork mince with 1 grated onion, 1 tbsp chopped sage, 40g breadcrumbs, 1 tsp salt and plenty of pepper. Halve 2 sheets puff pastry lengthways. Lay a log of the filling down each strip, roll up and seal the seam with beaten egg. Cut each log into 4, brush with egg and score the tops. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve hot with English mustard and tomato chutney.
Buttered popcorn with coloured sprinkles and popping candy
Popcorn popped in oil, tossed with melted butter and coloured sprinkles, with popping candy scattered over just before serving.
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with very pink buttercream and topped with a little sugar flower.
M: Grimmauld Place steak and kidney pie
Chuck steak and lamb kidney in rich gravy under puff pastry
Rich steak and kidney in gravy under a golden puff pastry lid. Brown 800g diced chuck and 200g lamb kidney, add an onion, 2 tbsp flour, 500ml beef stock and Worcestershire and simmer 2 hours.
Great Hall thyme roast chicken and gravy
dinner under the floating candles in the Great Hall

Chicken rubbed with butter and thyme, roasted at 200C for 75 minutes, with crispy roast potatoes, peas and gravy from the pan. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g soft butter, salt and thyme leaves and roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Parboil 1kg halved potatoes for 8 minutes, rough them up in the colander and roast in hot oil alongside the chicken for 50 minutes, turning once. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, whisk in 300ml chicken stock and simmer until thick. Serve with buttered peas and the gravy.
W: Golden syrup, lemon and breadcrumb filling in a shortcrust case
Shortcrust filled with warmed golden syrup, fresh breadcrumbs and lemon zest, baked at 180C for 30 minutes, served warm with cream.
K: Roasted pumpkin blended with apple juice, honey and cinnamon, chilled
Roasted pumpkin blended with apple juice, honey and cinnamon, strained and chilled.

dishes.make_ahead: Pop the corn up to 1 day ahead, airtight; toss with butter and sprinkles on the night and add the popping candy at the last second

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large lidded pot and pop the corn.
Toss with the melted butter and sprinkles.
Scatter popping candy over just before serving so it crackles.
Beat the cake butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs.
Fold in the flour and milk.
Spoon into cupcake cases.
Bake at 175C.
Cool completely.
Beat the icing butter, icing sugar and pink colouring.
Pipe on top and finish each with a sugar flower.

dishes.n: Grimmauld Place steak and kidney pie
dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, bake just before serving

steps.text: Trim and chop the steak and kidneys.
Brown the meat in the olive oil in batches.
Soften the onion.
Stir in the flour, stock and Worcestershire sauce.
Simmer until thick and tender.
Spoon into a pie dish, cool slightly and cover with the pastry.
Brush with egg and bake at 200C.

veg.n: Grimmauld Place mushroom and kidney bean pie
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, bake just before serving

steps.text: Cut the mushrooms into big chunks and drain the kidney beans.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Soften the onion.
Stir in the flour, stock and soy sauce, then add the mushrooms and kidney beans.
Simmer until thick.
Spoon into a pie dish, cool slightly and cover with the pastry.
Brush with egg and bake at 200C.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead and keep at room temperature; warm slices gently before serving with cream

steps.text: Line a tart tin with the pastry.
Blind bake the case.
Warm the golden syrup with the breadcrumbs and lemon zest and juice.
Pour into the case.
Bake at 180C until just set.
Cool slightly.
Serve warm slices with a pour of cream.
Chop the pumpkin.
Roast at 200C until soft.
Cool completely.
Blend with the apple juice, honey and cinnamon until smooth.
Strain into a jug and chill well.
Pour into goblets over ice.

s.note: Buttered popcorn with coloured sprinkles and popping candy
s.how: Heat a splash of oil in a large lidded pot and pop 100g popping corn. Toss with 60g melted butter and a big handful of coloured sprinkles. Scatter popping candy over just before serving so it crackles like a joke shop firework display.

Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Beat butter and icing sugar with pink colouring and pipe on top. Finish each with a little sugar flower.

m.n: Grimmauld Place steak and kidney pie
m.note: Chuck steak and lamb kidney in rich gravy under puff pastry
m.how: Brown 800g diced chuck and 200g lamb kidney, add an onion, 2 tbsp flour, 500ml beef stock and Worcestershire and simmer 2 hours. Spoon into a dish, cover with puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

w.note: Golden syrup, lemon and breadcrumb filling in a shortcrust case
w.how: Blind bake a shortcrust case. Warm 400g golden syrup with 100g fresh breadcrumbs and the zest and juice of a lemon, then pour into the case. Bake at 180C for 30 minutes until just set. Serve warm slices with a pour of cream.

d.note: Roasted pumpkin blended with apple juice, honey and cinnamon, chilled
d.how: Roast 300g butternut pumpkin until soft and cool completely. Blend with 1L apple juice, a spoon of honey and a pinch of cinnamon until smooth. Strain into a jug, chill well and pour into goblets over ice.
